title: ABU return file error by card
description: Event that occurs during processing of the ABU return file. Specifies the card and error that occurred to it.

examples.error_message: Old Account Number is not numeric

result_file_id.title: Result File ID
result_file_id.description: References the historical record of the file.

error_code.title: Error Code
error_code.description: Error code sent by Mastercard: `100` = Account override for deletion request, but not on Mastercard files; `101` = Old Account Number is not numeric; `102` = Old Account Number is not valid length; `104` = New Account Number is not numeric; `105` = New Account Number not valid length; `107` = New Account Number is not in the issuer BIN range; `108` = Old Expiration Date is invalid; `109` = New Expiration Date invalid; `110` = Invalid Reason Code or Invalid Header or Detail Record ID; `113` = Old Account Number exists in Mastercard database; `114` = New Account Number exists in Mastercard database; `118` = Old Account Number is not in Mastercard database; `119` = New Account Number is not in Mastercard database; `120` = Old Account Number is not in the issuer BIN range for an Initial Load (I); `121` = Old Account Number and New Account Number are not the same for an Expiration Date change (E).

error_message.title: Error Message
error_message.description: Error description sent by Mastercard. Each message corresponds to an `error_code` value. See `error_code` for the list of codes and messages.
examples: Old Account Number is not numeric

reason_code.title: Reason Code
reason_code.description: Automatic updater reason code: `I` = initial load (Mastercard only); `N` = new account (Mastercard only); `C` = closed account; `R` = replacement when card is reissued (Mastercard only); `A` = replacement when card is reissued (Visa only); `E` = expiration date update; `O` = opt-out; `B` = opt back in (Visa only).

ica.title: Interbank Card Association (ICA) number
ica.description: Interbank Card Association (ICA) number. The issuer's sign-on ID. A four-digit number MasterCard assigns to a financial institution to identify the member.
